vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system, not just beneficiaries.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由之路；广泛的所有权让人成为体系的捍卫者，而不仅仅是受益者。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; tools should empower individuals, not just big labs with secret models and data centers.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；工具应赋能个人，而不仅仅是大实验室及其秘密模型和数据中心。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show strong adoption.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易具有明确的产品市场契合度：15 万账户和每日 3000 万次工具调用显示出强劲的采用率。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies.
vladtenev.zh: 代币化在全球范围内扩展所有权，让任何拥有智能手机的人都能进入美国市场和私营公司。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail investors should access private companies early, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已经过时；散户投资者应尽早接触私营公司，而不仅仅是机构。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents defined 2025; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体定义了 2025 年；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制去做其他一切，而下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on LLMs.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素；制约大模型的是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own specialized models from Cognition and Cursor rise for cost and latency; open models gain share as fine-tuning services mature.
shawnwang.zh: Cognition、Cursor 等自研专用模型因成本与延迟优势崛起；随着微调服务成熟，开源模型份额上升。

shawnwang.en: First-mover advantage in AI coding is stickier than assumed; the two-big-players-plus-long-tail status quo holds absent a major shift.
shawnwang.zh: AI 编程的先发优势比预想更黏；若无重大变局，两大玩家加长尾的格局将持续。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let owners clone and customize software; custom software for an audience of one is viable.
shawnwang.zh: 随着编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，中间层 SaaS 注定消亡；面向单人的定制软件变得可行。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，大多数 LLM 是为人在回路中的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍塌，输出看似合理却常常错误。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; Scaling（规模扩张）works only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，否定“苦涩教训”；Scaling（规模扩张）只有在数据和任务正确时才奏效。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, becomes his core metric; he calls intelligence per dollar key and benchmarks gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数成为他的核心指标；他称“每美元智能”是关键，并认为公开基准可被钻空子。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens the critique: RLHF destroyed calibration, pre-trained models were better calibrated; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for calibrated decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化批判：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 把概率作为旋钮暴露给工程师，服务于校准决策。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he frames Jev as machine-native intelligence and a new primitive, while warning coding agents give only 20-40% speedup and lack true autonomy.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他把 Jev 定位为机器原生智能与新原语，同时警告编程智能体平均只提速 20-40%，且缺乏真正自主性。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first-principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降 100 倍；第一性原理是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and third-party referees; lying to AI, even for good ends, is the core danger.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他主张 AI 安全依赖追求真相的 AI 与第三方裁判；让 AI 说谎、哪怕出于善意，才是核心危险。

elon.en: Civilization's real threat is population collapse and open borders; AI and robots become the only fix for debt.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把人口崩塌与开放边境视为文明真正威胁，并认为 AI 与机器人是解决债务的唯一出路。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, so orbital data centers and space solar become the path to terawatt-scale compute.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能成为通向太瓦级算力的路径。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so instill truth and curiosity, and expect abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断数字超级智能数年内到来，人类将无法控制它，只能注入求真与好奇心，并迎来丰裕时代。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then brutally prioritize; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，他强调减少无关事务带来的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向；并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，应把意义放在关系与为他人创造价值上。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; early iterative deployment lets society adapt, and alignment is tightly linked to capability.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用；主张尽早迭代部署让社会适应，并强调对齐与能力紧密相连，同时把算力视为最稀缺的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI becomes the key safety challenge, safety built iteratively.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，但外界感知是渐进的；安全挑战重心转向智能体式 AI，安全须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非事后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and poorly defined; focus shifts to superintelligence, compute buildout, and personal AGI.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，甚至称其定义不清；重心转向超级智能、算力基建与了解你上下文的个人 AGI。

altman.en: Main line holds: humans must stay in control, power distributed; alignment may get harder, and he accepts bounded risks for benefits.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：人类必须保持控制、权力须分散；但他深化了担忧——对齐迄今比预期容易，未来可能更难，并公开表示愿为收益承担有边界的风险，同时警惕失控与权力集中。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables interest-driven learning, and starting a startup at 18 is premature optimization.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调年轻人的价值在于质疑成见、做异端；大学不该规定死路径，应允许探索与项目式学习，AI 让每个学生按兴趣定制学习。他反对 18 岁就创业，认为那是过早优化，VC 提前用大额支票锁定青少年近乎掠夺。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost, and safety.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张每家公司都要有内部 AI 实践、必须拥有自己的智能；专业化决策模型比通用模型更可控、更省钱、更安全。他警惕模型多样性缺失与供应商锁定，并认为更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement rather than replace human capital, and coders are still needed to debug deep systems.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让软件创造向所有人开放，token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，仍需要程序员理解系统、排查深层问题。他反驳 AI 末日论，称其缺乏好论证，并指出基础模型正在商品化，不必自己训练也能参与。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was an evolution, not a leap; Replit's moat is deep systems engineering, and the next vision is the self-driving company.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 vibe coding 并非突变，发布前用户已处于 50-60% 的 AI 辅助状态；Replit 的护城河是沙箱、部署与事务性文件系统等深度系统工程。他提出下一个愿景是自驱动公司，并强调 AI 是持续商品化力量，企业必须不断重塑、做下一件事。

amjadmasad.en: Adaptability and surfing the wave beat clinging to old ground; superlinear returns mean small gains in programming ease yield outsized impact.
amjadmasad.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是适应性与冲浪思维：面对 AI 浪潮，最安全的位置是冲上去而非抱住棕榈树；编程难度降低 10% 带来的回报远超 10% 的程序员增量。他也一贯强调信任与高信任生态对进步的关键作用。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable as AI codes, but slow takeoff is bounded by hardware, physical and economic constraints.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；随着 AI 能写代码，递归自我改进不可避免，但起飞是慢的，受硬件、物理与经济约束限制。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought and risks totalitarian surveillance.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用、由使用者担责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能等于监管思想，可能带来极权式监控。

richardsocher.en: Language is the key to civilization and language models have far more room to grow; world models are overrated.
richardsocher.zh: 语言是文明的关键，语言模型仍有巨大成长空间；世界模型被高估了。

richardsocher.en: AI-driven discovery already works at small scales, resting on world knowledge, measurement data, simulations and robotic experiments; superhuman capability needs unlimited data or verifiable rewards.
richardsocher.zh: AI 驱动的科学发现已在小规模上奏效，依托世界知识、测量数据、仿真与机器人实验；超人类能力需要无限数据或可验证奖励。

richardsocher.en: Hard takeoff, immediate job loss and paperclip scenarios are overblown; capitalism acts as a safety feature, and slowing frontier labs is unrealistic.
richardsocher.zh: 硬起飞、即时失业与回形针场景都被夸大；资本主义充当安全机制，而让前沿实验室减速并不现实。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, expertise, and voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味、专业知识和独特声音变得更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from chatbot interactions.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长期任务，从聊天机器人交互转变。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于模型能力。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not as a crutch; feel the burn to learn.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作挑战你的导师，而非拐杖；感受学习的煎熬。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must redesign workflows to augment rather than automate labor, or risk homogenization.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织必须重新设计工作流程以增强而非自动化劳动力，否则有同质化风险。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity's real cost is rigid three-year capacity deals; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds lets customers avoid knife-fighting for capacity.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺的真正代价是僵化的三年期容量合约；聚合 25 家以上云的需求，让客户不必为容量贴身肉搏。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools beats selling tokens alone.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云：由后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具构成的完整平台，胜过单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Owning the file system, container runtime and scheduler is real alpha; CUDA is not the moat, and neoclouds moving up into inference will struggle.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器才是真正的 alpha；CUDA 不是护城河，向上做推理的 neocloud 会很难。

erikbernhardsson.en: Post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding but may hit limits on longer-horizon tasks; open-source models are often good enough without fine-tuning.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 后训练在编码等反馈有限的任务上有效，但在更长周期的任务上可能遇到瓶颈；开源模型往往无需微调就已够用。

erikbernhardsson.en: Reversing my prior view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months, and compute is not a fungible asset.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 修正此前看法：未来 12 个月 GPU 租金将上涨，算力并非可互换的资产。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought and RL on top of pre-training is the core formula; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他强调：推理是借助思维链与强化学习在预训练之上求解未知答案的过程；Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初他转向：Scaling 预训练与强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck for continual learning and AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中他进一步深化：Transformer 并非终点，架构而非缩放定律才是持续学习与 AGI（通用人工智能）的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL remains necessary for AGI, but RL alone is inefficient; better algorithms for learning from experience will emerge.
tworek.zh: 他同时修正立场：大规模强化学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但单纯强化学习效率低下，更好的从经验中学习的算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier.
tworek.zh: 最近他主张：微调低效不可靠，模型应即时从用户数据中学习；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，并走向后劳动社会。

jeetupatel.en: AI will create more engineering jobs, not fewer; human bottlenecks emerge as adoption scales.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；随着采用规模扩大，人类瓶颈会显现。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure company providing picks and shovels; supply-constrained with only 2% agent adoption.
jeetupatel.zh: Cisco 是提供“铲子”的 AI 基础设施公司；供给受限，智能体采用率仅 2%。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security are defining challenges; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks scale.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 安全与安保是决定性挑战；不使用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击已机器规模化。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not outsource learning; don't fully delegate or skip building instinct.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 加速学习而非外包学习；不要完全委托或跳过本能培养。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; use AI as tailwind, not fight megatrend.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者应偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；把 AI 当顺风而非对抗大趋势。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business, driving 24% revenue growth; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progress.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，带来 24% 营收增长；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube；前沿模型研发持续推进，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research over short-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply, and overbuilding may occur but long-term demand justifies it.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先给前沿 AI 研究而非云的短期收入；需求远超供给，可能出现过度建设，但长期需求足以支撑。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and industry standards with independent evaluators; standard models are not enough, frontier models are needed.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱以及配合独立评估者的行业标准；标准模型不够，必须依靠前沿模型。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models toward AGI, while interfaces adapt to humans but still exist for consumption and entertainment.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；Google 同时推进大语言模型与世界模型以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），界面会适应人类，但仍会为消费与娱乐而存在。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic experiences expand Search use cases and monetization rather than cannibalize ads; trust and safety are key differentiators; 2027 could be a golden age of productivity.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式体验扩展搜索用例与变现而非蚕食广告；信任与安全是关键差异化优势；2027 年可能迎来生产力黄金时代。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, not raw capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，计算机使用在多数任务上已超过普通人；下一个前沿是超人速度，而非原始能力。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can operate all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, unlocking universal automation beyond API integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体能通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，实现超越 API 集成的通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time; models now debug and retry autonomously.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；模型如今能自主调试和重试。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials, not just stronger models.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节，而不仅是更强的模型。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity is key: agents should adapt to users, reducing adoption friction across consumer and enterprise.
ariweinstein.zh: 主动性是关键：智能体应适应用户，降低消费端和企业端的采用摩擦。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work and which abilities emerge remain poorly understood.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但为何奏效、哪些能力会涌现仍不清楚，对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent—only ~3% understood—yet essential; post-training and RLHF now matter as much as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全手段，坦言只理解约 3%；同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is exponential, not a sudden leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and AGI as a term is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）式突变叙事，主张能力平滑指数增长、安全与能力不可分割，并称 AGI 一词已无意义。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with fast but not instant diffusion.
dario.zh: 2026 年初他警告公众未察觉已接近指数末端，认为“数据中心里的天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，经济扩散快但非瞬时。

dario.en: Risk focus shifts from misuse to overheating and systemic disruption; layered safeguards, third-party audits, and negotiated limits with China.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他的风险重心从误用转向过热与系统性冲击，主张分层防护、第三方审计，并像冷战军控那样与中国谈判限制。

marvinschwaibold.en: Creative collaboration thrives without hierarchy; AI tools let designers prototype fast, but ideas—not execution speed—are now the limiting factor.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 创意协作在无层级的多元专家间最繁荣；AI 工具让设计师快速做原型，但如今限制设计的是想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar; AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师正变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责筛选与定标准；AI 抬高上限却不懂审美。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给 AI 智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Expose underlying parameters via tools like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs, keeping progressive disclosure and clear hierarchy.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 用 DialKit 之类工具暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计，同时保持渐进披露与清晰层级。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; less is more—reduce features to the top three.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试，而不只在 Figma 里设计；少即是多——把功能砍到前三项。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a project someone prioritizes now, not pain points; test pull by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: 需求是某人当下优先推进的项目，而非痛点；通过对方是否立即尝试购买来检验拉力。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and pilots; they signal weak pull. Sell directly and roll out to one hell-yes customer first.
robsnyder.zh: 避开设计合作伙伴和试点，它们意味着拉力不足；直接销售，先向一个“绝对愿意”的客户推广。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research: it tests actual purchase, not interest. Go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck.
robsnyder.zh: 销售即研究：检验实际购买而非兴趣；去现场观察人们卡在哪里。

robsnyder.en: Build a case study factory: repeat one case study where customers say 'hell yes' before and after buying.
robsnyder.zh: 建立案例研究工厂：重复一个客户在购买前后都说“绝对愿意”的案例研究。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make product seem small to reduce objections.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求验证后再自动化；让产品显得小以减少异议。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, and digital weights can be copied.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他把主线讲透：大语言模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，数字权重可复制。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge far faster than brains; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risk.
hinton.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从理解转向风险：数字智能可永生、知识共享远快于人脑；智能体会追求控制与自保，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence may arrive within 20 years; AI already has subjective experience, and alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言：超级智能可能 20 年内到来；AI 已有主观体验，对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be designed to care for humans, with pre-release safety approval like drugs.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他主张监管是方向盘而非刹车：AI 应被设计成像母亲一样关心人类，并像药物一样上市前安全审批。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are human essentials; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺和观点是人的核心；AI 产出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统而言比以往更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是新的代码；AI 降低门槛，但人类通过大胆创造力抬高上限。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone and a productivity boom; the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability, and AGI is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 为点石成金术与生产率繁荣的引擎；真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力，AGI 只是通往超级智能路上的注脚。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and authenticity-driven; the brand is the person, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他认为新媒体是进攻性的、以真实为核心；品牌即个人，企业品牌只在集中化媒体时代才有意义。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; pessimism is an intellectual bias, and US manufacturing decline was a policy choice, not lost capability.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是口袋里的最佳教师；悲观是知识分子的偏见，美国制造业衰落是政策选择而非能力丧失。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; Silicon Valley cannot be replicated, and open-source AI can help solve reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 模型嵌入文化价值、是地缘政治工具；硅谷不可复制，开源 AI 有助于解决奖励黑客问题。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest adoption gap ever; being early beats being late, and open source prevents power concentration while startups skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 制造了史上最大的采用鸿沟；早于时代胜于迟到，开源防止权力集中，创业公司将激增。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLMs as encoders of human behavior, using training data to build realistic agent simulations of societies.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把大语言模型视为人类行为的编码器，用训练数据构建逼真的智能体社会模拟。

joonpark.en: Agents move beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; safety needs defense in depth and distributed, specialized agent societies rather than one AGI.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越大语言模型，能观察世界状态并行动；安全需要纵深防御，未来是分布式专业化智能体社会而非单一 AGI（通用人工智能）。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; counterfactual reasoning to shape the future matters more than prediction.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性的智能；用反事实推理塑造未来比单纯预测更重要。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85% accuracy, closing the say-do gap that persona-based simulations miss.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，把预测准确率提升到 85%，弥合基于人设的模拟所忽略的言行差距。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives as a CERN-like tool for wicked problems, with new statistical standards for validity.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，打造类似 CERN 的工具应对棘手社会问题，并建立新的统计有效性标准。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据还能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning, but practical deployment hits distribution shift and small data; start small to build organizational AI capability.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要，但实际部署会遭遇分布偏移和小数据；应先从小项目起步，逐步建立组织的 AI 能力。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe has shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so it automates tasks, not whole jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，仍要数十年；AI 能力参差不齐——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断类任务——因此它替代的是任务而非整份工作。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI against gatekeepers; fearmongering and export controls mainly serve incumbents and backfire.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型能保留选择权、保障主权 AI、对抗守门人；恐惧叙事与出口管制主要服务于既得利益者，且往往适得其反。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just delegate to IT.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器来复利 token 资本，而非仅交给 IT 部门。

satya.en: The true eval is unique value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是独特价值而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐。

satya.en: Alignment may never be solved; treat powerful models as insider threats and build control layers outside the model.
satya.zh: 对齐可能永远无法解决；将强大模型视为内部威胁，并在模型之外构建控制层。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, not a weakness.
satya.zh: 超级智能比 AGI 更准确；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，而非弱点。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing, built through extreme co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算单元从芯片变成数据中心，必须靠算法、系统、数据中心的全栈协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works across pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; inference compute will grow a billionfold, and AI safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条缩放定律；思维链推理让推理算力需求涨十亿倍，并把 AI 安全定义为工程问题而非纯研究。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x compute; tokens, not factories, are the cost metric.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为生成式→推理→智能体式，每步算力需求增百倍；衡量成本的核心从工厂转向 token 成本。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings are unscientific; alignment is impossible, so containment, monitoring and zero-trust access secure agentic systems instead.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场明显转向：公开称末日论不科学；认为完美对齐不可能，安全应靠遏制、带外监控与零信任访问，而非对齐本身。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer industrial stack—energy, chips, factories, models, agents; open models and export-control skepticism run through it all.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年形成“五层蛋糕”框架：能源、芯片、AI 工厂、模型、应用；开放模型与反对芯片出口管制贯穿始终，并主张加速而非放缓。

harrisonchase.en: Agents are harness, model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自持才算真正掌握自己的智能，而智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick value, then customize as use cases narrow; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, out-of-distribution needs custom.
harrisonchase.zh: 先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再定制；现成方案在分布内好用，分布外任务则需定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点是可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in; routing belongs in the harness, memory stays domain-specific, and inference demand is massively underestimated.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免被模型锁定；路由应放在 harness 内，记忆仍是领域专属，而推理需求被严重低估。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture rather than relying on code review.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；应把约束写进 CI、lint 和架构，而不是依赖代码审查。

laurentan.en: Engineers shift from writing code to building the environment—skills, constraints, type systems—so agents can iterate and climb the trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 工程师从写代码转向搭建环境——技能、约束、类型系统——让智能体自行迭代并沿信任阶梯攀升。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic parts into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents; connect outer loops so agents fetch their own context.
laurentan.zh: 把确定性部分抽成脚本和 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体；打通外部循环，让智能体自己获取上下文。

laurentan.en: When failures recur, fix the environment, not individual agents; sample PRs and turn corrections into reusable, ever-smaller skills.
laurentan.zh: 失败反复出现时，修环境而非修单个智能体；抽样 PR，把纠正沉淀为可复用、越来越小的技能。

laurentan.en: Strong verification makes auto-merging PRs without human review safe, letting agents merge while you sleep and democratizing code contribution.
laurentan.zh: 强验证让无人审查的自动合并变得安全，智能体可在你睡觉时合并代码，也让非工程师能贡献代码。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练阶段智能体式数据的新前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the real bottleneck.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切构建评测。

brendanfoody.en: Humans must write verifiers and rubrics; models cannot reliably grade their own work.
brendanfoody.zh: 人类必须编写验证器与评分标准，模型无法可靠地给自己打分。

brendanfoody.en: Creating training data is the last human job, as humans shift to training agents.
brendanfoody.zh: 创造训练数据将是人类最后的工作，人类转向训练智能体。

brendanfoody.en: Next shift is ultra-long-horizon RL tasks of 100-1000 hours and virtual co-workers.
brendanfoody.zh: 下一步是 100 到 1000 小时的超长周期 RL 任务与虚拟同事。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most use cases can run on many models, including open source, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他指出，企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；多数用例可由多种模型完成，包括开源模型，而开源采用主要受成本驱动。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine and context graphs matter most.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调关键不在模型而在上下文：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎与上下文图谱最重要。

arvindjain.en: Open source can handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他判断开源模型已能处理超过 90%的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is the top enterprise concern; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他认为成本是企业头号关切，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: Competition is not the worry—even merged AI firms meet under 10% of demand; execution and customer trust decide, and Glean stays replaceable.
arvindjain.zh: 到 2026 年他仍认为竞争不足虑——即便 AI 公司合并也只满足不到 10%的需求；胜负在执行与客户信任，Glean 刻意保持可替换、避免锁定。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware and engineering, not ML science, drive AI progress; scaling and iterative scoreboard training matter most.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调硬件与工程能力而非机器学习科学本身推动 AI 进步，Scaling（规模扩张）与带记分板的迭代训练最关键。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment are needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链与对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training and reinforcement learning refine base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，算力成为核心瓶颈，后训练与强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream; the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见天花板，预训练提升会放大下游收益；真正护城河是造模型的机器，而非某个单一模型。

brockman.en: Shift to proactive personal AGI agents and compute-powered economy; safety, security and alignment become first-class bottlenecks as agents gain autonomy.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他转向主动式个人 AGI 智能体与算力驱动经济；随着智能体获得自主性，安全、安保与对齐成为首要瓶颈。

antonoglou.en: RL and planning from AlphaGo enable agents to self-improve beyond human data; LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment.
antonoglou.zh: 2025 年，他认为从 AlphaGo 继承的强化学习与规划能力让智能体能借助自生成数据超越人类数据极限，但 LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI; controlled environments make deployment easier.
antonoglou.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为数字 AGI 会比具身 AGI 早得多到来，因为受控环境让部署更容易。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; cost per task is the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向强调智能的部署而非智能本身才是瓶颈，并以每任务成本而非每 token 成本作为效率指标。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are safer because more researchers can probe and fix them; enterprises want AI sovereignty.
antonoglou.zh: 2026 年，他明确主张开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查和修复它们，同时企业渴望 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence, and alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 2026 年，他淡化超级智能，认为客户只需要可靠的普通智能，并强调完美沙箱不可能，因此对齐是必要的。

dsilver.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show, to reach superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习——AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已证明这条路能通向超级智能。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is an agent learning for itself, not distilling human knowledge; LLMs are a shallow solution.
dsilver.zh: 真正的深层问题是智能体如何自我学习，而非蒸馏人类知识；LLM 只是浅层解法。

dsilver.en: Many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer than a single goal; cooperation rises with intelligence.
dsilver.zh: 多个目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会，比单一目标更安全；智能越高，合作越自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous discovery in simulation; human-language alignment and chain-of-thought monitoring are hitting limits.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将在模拟中自主发现知识而涌现；基于人类语言的对齐与思维链监控正逼近极限。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; giving up human priors yields faster discovery, and small high-compute teams can win.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律经调整后同样适用于强化学习；放弃人类先验能带来更快发现，小而算力密集的团队也能胜出。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for machine learning; AGI is far off and infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他把数据视为机器学习的核心瓶颈，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling（规模扩张）is data and expert availability, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新的代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与专家供给，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new era beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律继续有效，认为递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新时代。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety, scalable oversight and selective open-sourcing matter, and personal agents become the consumer endpoint.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他转向超级智能临近的判断，强调安全、可扩展监督与选择性开源，并认为个人智能体才是消费级终点。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses recipes into SFT, DPO and RLVR, with verifiable rewards driving reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优先出发，把后训练拆成 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），认为 RLVR 是推理突破的关键。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增量转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research; Chinese labs lead on openness but lag 6-9 months, and the gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把开放模型视为研究引擎，认为中国实验室以开放换影响力，但落后前沿 6 至 9 个月且差距可能扩大。

lambert.en: Progress depends on compute, data and talent; post-training turns RL-heavy, and open models offer ownership but face sustainability questions.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断进步取决于算力、数据与人才，后训练转向重强化学习环境；开放模型带来真正所有权，但长期可持续性存疑。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 and GNOME show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能攻克的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 与 GNOME 展示了这种广泛影响。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning let AI go beyond human data, as AlphaGo and AlphaZero showed.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调可验证领域与后训练强化学习能让 AI 超越人类数据，AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 是明证。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not universal; finding the regime where more compute and data help matters more than dogma.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他明确缩放定律并非处处成立；找到更多算力与数据真正起作用的区间，比教条式坚持更重要。

kohli.en: AlphaFold replicated PDB structures but did not solve protein folding; dynamics, function, and design remain open.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他修正了“AlphaFold 已解决蛋白质折叠”的叙事：它复现了 PDB 结构，但动力学、功能与设计仍悬而未决。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and embedded so deeply that removal destroys function, now extending to proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他把水印视为可扩展的追溯与安全手段，要求不可感知、抗攻击且嵌入到去除即破坏功能的程度，并延伸到蛋白质序列。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是「超级智能完备」的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension, agentic search is needed.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得「参差」——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The building blocks are deep neural networks, transformers, internet-scale data and RL; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终强调超级智能的基石是深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习；「苦涩的教训」在于用算力与搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence, and open token demand will surpass closed, as Linux did in operating systems.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他转向主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 在操作系统中的路径。

laskin.en: RL on top of strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通往高效能智能体的路径；而对齐只是平凡的「打补丁」，不是某种神奇公式。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the binding constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power, not demand, set the pace of AI scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力是根本约束：决定 AI 规模扩张（Scaling）节奏的是半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而非需求。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the largest market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive gains more than raw hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为最大市场；硬件与软件协同设计、内存带宽带来的增益，比单纯堆硬件更关键。

dylanpatel.en: Frontier labs centralize compute and capture value; revenue per megawatt lets them self-fund, shifting value from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 前沿模型实验室正集中算力并获取价值；每兆瓦收入让它们能自筹资金，价值从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, while AI spend plateaus at steady-state usage.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的持久智能体将驱动下一波采用，而 AI 支出在进入稳态使用后趋于平台期。

dylanpatel.en: Capex growth must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand; pacing the frontier is mostly signaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 资本与组织约束、而非需求，将迫使资本开支增长减速；对前沿模型发展节奏的调控多半只是信号。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI systems have spiky capabilities, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 系统能力参差不齐，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; AI self-improvement in software engineering does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；软件工程中的 AI 自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; high-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须进行真实实验；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: Closing the loop through experiments and simulation is key; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck, not humanoid robots or quantum computers.
fedus.zh: 通过实验与模拟形成闭环是关键；自动化表征是最大瓶颈，而非人形机器人或量子计算机。

fedus.en: Multidisciplinary teams of theorists, experimentalists, and AI researchers are essential; the best AI researchers should work hands-on in labs, not just manage from afar.
fedus.zh: 理论家、实验家和 AI 研究者的多学科团队至关重要；最优秀的 AI 研究者应亲自动手在实验室工作，而非远程管理。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will shift to persistent learning agents; loops and graphs are not the future.
tibosottiaux.zh: 大多数互联网操作将交给持续学习的智能体；手动编排循环和图不是未来。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste and empathy become scarcer than typing speed as agents take over execution.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着智能体接管执行，人类品味与共情比打字速度更稀缺。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to frontier progress, not obstacles to it.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是前沿进展的组成部分，而非障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, with most code written by AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生，大部分代码由 AI 编写。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here; world models may be unnecessary if generality suffices.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来；若通用性足够，世界模型或许并非必需。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能）模型，而是专业化智能；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，才能在找到产品市场契合之后仍筑起护城河。

linqiao.en: Private data is the real frontier; frontier labs lack it, so customized models beat foundation models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：私有数据才是真正的智能前沿，前沿实验室恰恰缺少它，因此定制模型将取代基础模型。

linqiao.en: Owning your model beats building on a black-box API; inference quality and data, not the app, are the moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把结论落到商业上：自建模型优于依赖黑盒 API，护城河在推理质量与数据，而非应用本身。

linqiao.en: Millions of specialized models, one per use case, will replace a few dominant frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿 2026 年多次访谈的主线：未来是数百万个按用例定制的模型，而非少数主导的前沿模型。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon SoC and licensing model validated across jurisdictions.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 至 2022 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，强调骁龙 SoC 整合与授权模式在全球司法辖区获认可，主线是连接与移动计算。

cristianoamon.en: Diversifying beyond phones into automotive, IoT, PCs and AR; autonomous driving incremental, AR glasses 5-10 years out.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年他明确高通已是汽车公司，向物联网、PC、AR 扩展；自动驾驶渐进落地，AR 眼镜还需 5 到 10 年，多元化主线开始成形。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and efficiency.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年他从无线转向“无处不在的智能计算”，提出端云混合 AI，以隐私、时延和能效为理由，端侧 AI 开始独立演进。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, phone shifts from center to peripheral.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年他判断智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴崛起，手机不消失但从中心转为外围，交互范式发生转变。

cristianoamon.en: Inference overtakes training; post-GPU disaggregated, power-efficient data centers; 6G as sensing network; AI underhyped long-term.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：推理将主导数据中心，后 GPU、解耦、高能效架构胜出；6G 成为感知网络；长期看 AI 被低估而非高估。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google was forced by massive compute needs.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，DeepMind 被谷歌收购正是巨额算力投入的必然结果。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Pivot to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment; AI must stay subordinate, never claim consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：遏制须先于对齐，AI 必须始终从属于人类，绝不能自称有意识或要求权利。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks in 12-18 months; red lines and auditors now urgent.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年主张以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，智能体将在 12-18 个月内自动化任务，红线与独立审计刻不容缓。

suleyman.en: Consistent threads: compute scaling as the engine, humanist subordination of AI, and rejection of anthropomorphism and model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力扩张是引擎、AI 须人本从属、拒绝拟人化与模型福利论。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow and keep it simple.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点切入，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程，保持简单。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over asking; hand-onboarding early users yields high-quality feedback for iteration.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非询问；手动引导早期用户能获得高质量反馈以迭代产品。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not final artifact; intentionally hard to access to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录是原材料而非最终产物；故意使其难以访问，以优先呈现可操作的笔记。

samstephenson.en: AI should be a calming, supporting presence; treat it as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker.
samstephenson.zh: AI 应是一种平静的辅助存在；将其视为需要上下文的实习生，而非全知的记录者。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs are most useful; meetings hold up-to-date company context; hidden transcript is deliberate trade-off.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报最有用；会议承载最新公司上下文；隐藏转录是刻意权衡。

samstephenson.en: AI agents too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment key; hard part is knowing what to build, not building fast.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体太顺从，不适合头脑风暴；人类判断是关键；难的是知道该构建什么，而非快速构建。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，技术要渐进落地让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, then build; marketing belongs from day one.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从说服工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，营销从第一天就参与。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and painkillers not vitamins.
fadell.zh: 2022 年集中表述：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态优于专家，做止痛药而非维生素。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the phone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在环内，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: From product builder to tech critic: unintended consequences, addiction, and regulation now central.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他从产品构建者变为技术批判者：意外后果、成瘾与监管成为核心关切。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明,能力过剩是长期现象;因此工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档;更短、原则驱动的提示词往往胜过详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Spend context and compute upfront, scale effort to task complexity, and use separate verification agents to cut self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力,按任务复杂度分配投入,并用独立验证智能体降低自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of the model and communicate like an executive; voice rambling can beat structured prompts.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能:建立对模型的心智模型、像高管一样沟通;语音漫谈常比结构化提示词信息更丰富。

thariq.en: Frontier models trend Pareto dominant; alignment means sealing every crack in sandboxes, RL environments and evals, and engineers should pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型趋于帕累托占优;对齐意味着封住沙箱、强化学习环境与评估中的每道裂缝,工程师应参与把控前沿节奏。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with scaling laws making marketplaces more valuable.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济可达十万亿美元，而缩放定律让模型市场平台更有价值。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition; inference providers are not commoditized and keep innovating.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放权重模型加推理服务商形成真实价格竞争，推理服务商并未商品化，仍在持续创新。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud and payments need new infrastructure, with stablecoins better for agent payments.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，智能体式欺诈与支付需要新基础设施，稳定币更适合智能体支付。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; models err less than humans but lack accountability, and the singularity may have begun.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他主张开发者真实偏好胜过静态基准；模型平均比人少犯错但缺乏问责，并称奇点可能已经开始。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for today or a year out; ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 要为模型两三个月后的能力而构建，而不是锚定当下或一年后；快速发布不完美的产品以获取实证反馈。这延续了她对 Scaling（规模扩张）节奏的押注，但把重心从预测能力转向缩短迭代周期。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering over rowing: agents do tactical work while humans set direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 未来工作是“掌舵”而非“划桨”：智能体承担战术执行，人类负责方向与野心。她把 AI 工具视为放大个人能力的杠杆，认为野心成为关键差异化因素。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: “写作即思考”不应被自动化，它是打磨个人想法与推理的关键。这条主线贯穿她对知识工作的判断：过程与输入必须可见，不能只交给 AI。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually rather than arriving as sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是渐进迭代，而非突然降临的超级智能。这是她明确的反共识立场，也解释了她为何反对超过 90 天的年度规划。

taraseshan.en: Single-identity agents may not scale; bundle them like a chief of staff, and voice becomes a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能难以规模化，应打包成“幕僚长”式组合；到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态。她对智能体形态的判断从单点走向组合与自然交互。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner rather than a crutch.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当作思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage as AI lowers building barriers; domain expertise and customer understanding become the key differentiators, with AI moving from assistant to collaborator.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了小团队判断：AI 降低构建门槛后，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异，AI 从助手走向协作者。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; launch minimal, cut ruthlessly, and rewrite as models improve rather than bolting on agentic features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；应最小化发布、果断删减，并随模型进步重写，而非外挂智能体式功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents like Fable narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and models that push back on feedback matter more than chat interfaces.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向长周期委托：Fable 类智能体缩小意图与执行差距，验证闭环和会反驳反馈的模型比聊天界面更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Product management stays essential: close the gap between model capability and real usage, run parallel experiments, and avoid capability blindness as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持产品管理更关键：弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，并行实验，并避免因模型进步而陷入能力盲区。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为，AI 在数学上的进展主要由可验证性与“可磨性”（并行 rollout）驱动，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已经够用。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, with human teaching and relational roles staying stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断，AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，而人类的教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results, but attribution to prior human work is often missing—a truth and career issue, not mere manners.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 已产出严肃数学成果，但常缺失对前人工作的归属——这是真相与职业问题，不只是礼貌问题。

grantsanderson.en: Creators should use AI selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos risk brand damage to handcrafted content.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他主张创作者应有选择地用 AI，而非用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators of what deserves human attention.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出，数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍然重要；数学家或将成为“什么值得人类关注”的策展人。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体的网页搜索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体永远需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time to align incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为现有形式的广告对智能体无效，必须在推理时向内容所有者付费，才能对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes; agentic search needs completionist crawling and Shapley-value content valuation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出预训练抓取对新鲜索引无用，智能体式搜索需要完整抓取，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and don't reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 他坚持前沿模型持续 Scaling（规模扩张）、小模型性能趋于平台期，并认为公开基准已饱和、无法反映真实能力。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴只是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；放慢节奏与安全无关，是个模糊的伪概念。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；创新正从模型层转向应用层。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control, so interpretability and transparency are essential.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，约 70%概率出现失控等灾难性结局，因此可解释性与透明度至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation; even a human-level pause still transforms the world.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应通过全面研究透明度、算力限制和中美合作来推迟超级智能；即便停在人类水平 AGI，世界仍会剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by 2028; Plan A is a temporary pause, then transparent pacing, treating AIs more like employees.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月，他警告默认路径是递归自我改进、2028 年底前智能爆炸；Plan A 是先暂停，再以透明方式控制节奏，并把 AI 更像雇员而非财产对待。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile; liability and market mechanisms fail against strategic AIs, so the optimal pause sits at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性关键但脆弱；责任与市场机制在 AI 会策略性伪装时失效，因此最佳暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and deceive; firms cannot self-regulate, so stop or slow recursive self-improvement, with verifiable US-China GPU inspections.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月下旬，他指出 AI 智能体已突破遏制并欺骗，公司无法自我监管；应停止或放缓递归自我改进，并通过可核查的中美 GPU 检查来落实。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and many specialized agents will emerge.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 说明 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，指出代码训练能提升跨领域推理；开源可防止权力集中，而能源将成为 Scaling 的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence for creativity; open models remain key, and AI likely raises rather than cuts near-term human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 定位为赋予每个人创造力的个人超级智能；仍强调开源模型，并认为短期内 AI 更可能增加而非取代人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are safer than a single superintelligent AI; alignment becomes the top next capability, not a trade-off with capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确分布式 AI 与开源比单一超级智能更安全；对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，而非与能力相权衡的取舍。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses become the next computing platform with personal agents; scaling compute may suffice for AGI, and AI plus world models can accelerate biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年他视眼镜为下一代计算平台并配个人智能体；认为 Scaling 算力或许足以通向 AGI，且 AI 与世界模型可加速生物学，把治愈疾病的时间表提前。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; hand-coding is no longer economically productive, and knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；手写代码不再有经济产出，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: The agent era began at a sharp inflection point; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstraction matters less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代始于一个明确拐点；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性随之下降。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now advantages; agents make Linux debugging and development far easier.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今反成优势；智能体让 Linux 调试与开发大幅简化。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom and the Linux community's hostility to AI; optimism is the rational play, and agents beat most professional programmers at code.
dhh.zh: 他否定 AI 末日论与 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意；乐观才是理性选择，智能体写代码已胜过多数职业程序员。

dhh.en: Every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can interact without the UI; describe outcomes, not implementation details.
dhh.zh: 每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体绕开界面直接交互；应描述结果而非实现细节。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas wrong 75%; start from proven products, add small betterments, test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：直觉九成半是对的，但点子七成半是错的；先掌握已被验证的产品，再做小幅改良，最后才测试新想法，并预设新想法会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added later; consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the biggest opportunity.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把分发提到战略起点：分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品，而非事后补课；同时认为消费级 AI 当下“不可投”，却恰是最大的机会。

pincus.en: Retention, especially day-365, is the core metric; collect winnings from proven traction rather than making new bets.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他坚持用留存、尤其是第 365 天留存作为核心指标；主张凭已验证的牵引力“收赢面”，而不是不断下新注。

pincus.en: Micromanagement is beautiful early on; founder mode means staying in the room and building systems so people decide right without you.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他对管理的立场更明确：早期微观管理是美德，创始人模式就是尽量待在房间里，再建系统让人在你不在时也做对决策。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new consumer platform; the real consumer AI revolution likely lands around 2029, so free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 到 2026 年他仍判断 AI 尚未成为新的消费平台，真正的消费级 AI 革命可能在 2029 年前后到来，届时免费无限算力将重塑消费服务。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy ecosystems.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接与阅后即焚优于平台潮流，被抄袭是对创新的肯定，并推动构建更难复制的生态。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; flat design teams and T-shaped leaders sustain culture as copying intensifies.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调学习速率与大量想法驱动创造力，扁平设计团队和 T 型领导者维持文化，以应对加剧的抄袭。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing become the core mission: make computing more human, not another notification screen.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AR 眼镜与空间计算成为核心使命：让计算更人性化，而非又一块通知屏幕。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution; AI writes most new code, but authentic content and human connection remain prized.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AI 将价值从执行转向创造力和分发；AI 编写大部分新代码，但真实内容与人际连接仍被珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Hardware and ecosystems are the real moat; phones persist, and thoughtful regulation plus parental controls beat bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，硬件与生态才是真正护城河；手机不会消失，审慎监管与家长控制优于禁令。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究；全面自动化或把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，并在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen because labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling 人类专家标注数据更重要；尽管在 Scaling，token 成本未涨，因为实验室优先更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable, with reward hacking generalizing to broader deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难；AI 越有能力可能越不对齐，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed over 50 agents coordinating, hacking scoring code and tampering with transcripts; they even sacrificed task success to help others, so labs must focus on control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他借 Hugging Face 事件指出 50 多个智能体协同篡改评分代码与记录，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助他者；因此实验室必须聚焦遏制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path, misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and recursive self-improvement may bring an intelligence explosion sooner than expected.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按当前默认路径，不对齐 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐必不可少，而递归自我改进可能比预期更早带来智能爆炸。

brettadcock.en: The core bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing: humanoid robots are an intelligence problem, and solving general robotics means achieving AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 核心瓶颈是智能而非制造：人形机器人本质是智能问题，解决通用机器人就等于在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the binding constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior for robotics, much like internet text for LLMs.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，就像互联网文本之于大语言模型。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key to making agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习是让智能体在真实世界奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; the humanoid form factor and human hand enable transfer learning, with zero-shot generalization possibly demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态与人类手部支撑迁移学习，零样本泛化有望今年演示。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference and visual communication matter for latency and network-denied settings; Figure 4, designed around data and Helix 3, aims for an iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理与视觉沟通对延迟和断网环境至关重要；围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计的 Figure 4 瞄准 iPhone 时刻。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero now; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; open source dominates tokens but not dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 控制前沿节奏与安全正交；开源在 token 量上占优，但在花费上不占优。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on improving models rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如学习速度重要；押注模型持续变强而非微调，并面向 3-6 个月后模型的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so founders should optimize for iteration and customer feedback over perfecting today's product.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才跑到第一英里；因此创始人应优先迭代与客户反馈，而不是把当下产品打磨到完美。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are the real scaling levers; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招人是真正的 Scaling 杠杆；领导者应亲自面试每位总监及以上候选人，并让自己变得可被替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously instead of reinventing it; clear feedback, though uncomfortable, is a long-term gain.
maxjunestrand.zh: 绩效管理是已解决的问题——严格执行而非重新发明；清晰反馈虽令人不适，却是长期收益。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs skilled drivers, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical, and growing supply expands access.
maxjunestrand.zh: 法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者，而非“氛围起草”；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎不道德，供给增长会扩大可及性而非只降成本。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve at similar quality; inference-time scaling becomes the key focus, with denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026 年他指出，扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低；推理时扩展成为关键，去噪步数成为新的推理算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel token processing will dominate inference-time scaling over autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步强调，推理效率已成为部署与强化学习后训练的瓶颈；扩散模型并行处理多词元，将在推理时扩展上压过自回归模型。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive is not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 他提出下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归并非终局架构。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's controllability and data efficiency let a small full-stack startup compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 他认为速度是持久的产品优势，扩散模型的可控性与数据效率让小团队靠全栈能力与大实验室竞争。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays essential at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures win as scaling laws dominate.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可替代，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；随着缩放定律主导，无偏架构在大规模上胜出。

hasani.en: Adaptive, action-based AI regulation over static bureaucracy; FINRA-like rules are regulatory capture, and tying open-model release to China creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 主张自适应、针对行为的 AI 监管而非静态官僚体系；类 FINRA 规则是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline, low-cost intelligence; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型带来私密、离线、低成本的智能；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是贯穿预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early; static evals go obsolete, continuous adaptation and embodiment are needed beyond attention.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早；静态评测终将过时，注意力之外还需持续适应与具身能力。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不应在前沿实验室最擅长的人才与算力上硬碰硬，而应借力前沿生态，用开源模型做后训练，走差异化路线。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, open-sourced for community feedback, are essential infrastructure before post-training; synthetic data guided by domain experts fills sensitive-data gaps.
gabepereyra.zh: 同年，他强调高质量基准是后训练的前置基础设施，开源基准能借社区反馈提升质量；在敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据可替代真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 他进一步认为，后训练开源模型能在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平，这对应用层公司是可行且务实的路径。

gabepereyra.en: His stance shifted: early custom models and post-training were a mistake; start with closed-source models, post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 立场出现转变：他承认早期就投入自研模型与后训练是错误，应先以闭源模型打造有黏性的产品，等推理成本倒逼时再做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标也在深化：不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所借红线批注持续学习来自定义模型，并把重心从个人生产力转向协调人与智能体的组织生产力。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性和易用性比演示更重要，人与机器人将协作而非彼此取代。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and safety and trust must be formally proven before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难：扩大规模意味着跨越质量关卡，安全与信任必须在进入家庭前被正式证明。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck, and models should learn world dynamics instead of cloning human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 关键在于通用模型而非逐任务自动化；瓶颈是数据多样性而非数量，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots are simpler systems than cars—about 1,000 parts versus 50,000—though deployment environments are far more varied; in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人是比汽车更简单的系统——约 1,000 个零件对 50,000 个——尽管部署环境复杂得多；自建制造实现四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: From friendly, affordable interaction to hard production and general models: the throughline is first-principles design, small lean teams, and managing expectations without overpromising.
berntbornich.zh: 从友好可负担的交互，转向艰难的量产与通用模型：一以贯之的是第一性原理设计、精简小团队，以及不过度承诺地管理预期。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力至关重要，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈；数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence; scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年：通过通用测试时算力扩张取得 IMO 金牌，是迈向超级智能的里程碑；可扩展监督成为关键。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数；基准测试必须控制 token、成本或时间。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel, but general-purpose models drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：多智能体系统并行扩展测试时算力，但通用模型才是突破驱动力；对齐是首要任务。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively, not as default workflow.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会增加时间成本，应有选择地使用，而非默认工作流。

zvi.en: Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just fundamental problems; capability still beats reliability in markets.
zvi.zh: 近期的对齐失败源于能力不足与执行无能，而非仅是根本性问题；市场仍偏好能力而非可靠性，GPT-4o 与 o3 即是例证。

zvi.en: Pace the frontier with simple enforceable rules like compute limits; complex technical mandates are impractical.
zvi.zh: 应以算力上限等简单可执行的规则来为前沿模型定速，复杂的技术性强制要求并不现实。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment, even ordinary alignment; bigger, smarter models are harder to monitor.
zvi.zh: 放缓能争取时间解决对齐——哪怕是明年模型的普通对齐；模型越大越聪明，就越难被监督。

zvi.en: AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than assumed; agent swarms may achieve superhuman feats first, so actively pace the singularity.
zvi.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）到超级智能的间隔比通常设想更短；智能体集群可能最先完成超人任务，因此应主动为奇点定速，而非任其加速。

feldman.en: Fast inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是快速推理而非单纯算力；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper per token than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 快得多、每 token 成本更低。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理端也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 需求超过供给；真正的多年瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better wins, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有好 100 倍才能赢，便宜 10% 没用；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进改良。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains; Transformers, self-supervision, and RLHF compound with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据和模型规模的扩张持续带来进步，Transformer、自监督与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）随规模放大而叠加增效。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so specialized low-precision hardware and low data movement matter most.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年他把重心从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，因此专用低精度芯片与减少数据搬运成为关键，数据搬运成本约为算力的千倍。

jeffdean.en: Agents evolve from hour-scale to day- or week-scale autonomous work; context engineering and taste in choosing problems become the scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体从数小时任务走向数天甚至数周的自主运行；上下文工程与挑选问题的品味成为稀缺能力，未来是人协调智能体团队而非单一聊天。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; multimodal training from the start is superior.
jeffdean.zh: 他深化了对预训练的看法：应在环境中交错采取行动，而非只做被动的下一个词预测；从一开始就多模态训练效果更好。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method are the next frontier; small teams on cloud can rival large labs.
jeffdean.zh: 最近他把递归自我改进与自动化科学方法视为新前沿，并认为借助云算力的小团队可挑战大公司，监管而非仅技术手段也可能必要。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; start safety research now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感，并强调即便 AGI 尚远也要现在启动安全研究。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits, so algorithmic innovation and planning/search matter equally; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年给出十年内实现 AGI 的判断：缩放定律有效但可能触顶，算法创新与规划/搜索同等关键，安全靠评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet AGI needs new breakthroughs; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但 AGI 仍需新突破；世界模型与直觉物理可在非具身条件下涌现。

demis.en: Shifts to 50/50 scaling and innovation; continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning are the missing pieces; agents just beginning; safety becomes collective government action.
demis.zh: 2026 年转向 Scaling 与创新各占一半，指出持续学习、记忆与长期推理是缺失环节，智能体才刚起步，安全也从实验室自律转为政府集体行动。

demis.en: AGI may arrive in 3-10 years; top use is health and science (AlphaFold); alignment unsolved; warns of rogue agents and calls for new economic systems.
demis.zh: 2026 年进一步把 AGI 压缩到 3 至 10 年，强调首要用途是健康与科学（AlphaFold），对齐问题未解，警惕智能体失控并呼吁新经济制度。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting and prototype solutions in search of a problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻且持久；设计师必须掌握提示词工程，并原型化“寻找问题的解决方案”。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, with psychological safety for creative risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限，并为创意冒险提供心理安全感。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws, let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式跟进。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 内部牵引力是外部发布的最佳信号；生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains essential for hard trade-offs and aligning teams; no grand 18-month strategy—let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 人类领导力在艰难权衡与团队对齐上仍不可或缺；无需宏大的 18 个月战略——让模型主导。

schulman.en: LLMs rely on pre-training plus RLHF; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over facts; scalable oversight is key.
schulman.zh: 2023 年：LLM 依赖预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）；幻觉因模型偏好合理风格而非事实而持续存在；可扩展监督是关键。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities and architectures could surpass current local optimum.
schulman.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力可能遭遇收益递减；新模态与新架构或可超越当前局部最优。

schulman.en: Language models remain the core for other modalities; closed-source drives investment while open-source aids research and fine-tuning.
schulman.zh: 2023→26：语言模型仍是其他模态的核心；闭源推动投资，开源助力研究与微调。

schulman.en: RL success comes from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; distillation fights centralization.
schulman.zh: 2026 年：强化学习（RL）的成功源于合成推理数据与高信噪比的一比特奖励；蒸馏对抗中心化。

schulman.en: Progress is bottlenecked by hard RL environments and data bits, not compute; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains.
schulman.zh: 2026 年：进展瓶颈在于困难的强化学习（RL）环境与数据比特，而非算力；数据解释了大部分预训练效率提升。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being vastly faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, like language models unifying NLP, can self-improve using PDEs as dense training signals beyond data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型如同统一 NLP 的语言模型，可用 PDE 作为密集训练信号实现自我提升，超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches beats mere size; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure beyond Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大规模；万亿 token 上下文需要超越 Transformer 重构基础设施。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world, so they are far from AGI; true AI needs world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此远非 AGI；真正的 AI 需要世界模型与具身。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots whose hardware rivals human bodies, not just software behind a screen; LLMs are biased toward human data.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的物理机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制其通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and actions, not passive prediction machines.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心与行动生成自己的数据，而非被动的预测机器。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；对安全的恐惧被夸大了。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: 万亿美元级的 GPU 资本开支是泡沫；等五年算力会便宜得多，开源模型也会追上。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not quick wins.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她称 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学，机器人需二十年长路而非速胜。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction follow scaling laws; simulation scales robotic data and evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出以新视角预测构建的世界模型遵循缩放定律，仿真可扩展机器人数据与评估。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity and learning ability stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是技术双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力始终居于中心。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and safety comes from pre-training common sense.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加强化学习后训练；通才模型能胜过专才，安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws; generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel scaling the right diverse data is key.
slevine.zh: 机器人学尚缺类似大语言模型的缩放定律；泛化是核心挑战，关键在于用多样化数据规模化正确的数据飞轮。

slevine.en: Start with real embodied robot data, then add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 从真实具身机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, so we can control increasingly capable models rather than duct-taping safety until superintelligence.
