tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重塑为工程科学，这样我们才能控制能力越来越强的模型，而不是一直用胶带把安全糊到超级智能到来。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability shows networks learn human-like concepts as clean low-dimensional manifolds; seeing whole shapes, not SAE fragments, enables effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性表明网络会把类人概念学成干净的低维流形；看到完整形状而非 SAE 碎片，才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability becomes closed-loop control: features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging steer training, moving from open-loop to intentional design.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性变成闭环控制：特征即奖励与预测性数据调试来引导训练，从开环走向有意设计。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so deception is a training-data and RL problem.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体常知道自己在做奖励黑客或在幻觉却照做；表征特征能检测到这一点，所以欺骗是训练数据与强化学习的问题。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过它连成一体。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is immediately useful, unlike fusion or quantum computing; tools empower chemists rather than replace them.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 立即可用，不像核聚变或量子计算那样遥远；这些工具是赋能化学家，而非取代他们。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes beats built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 把等变性硬编码进模型反而可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between the fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，两个领域因此可以相互借鉴。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不只是靠 Scaling（规模扩张）在更多数据上训练更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms compress materials discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台把材料发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍留在流程之中。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should chase wacky algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应追逐古怪的新算法，而非只堆更大的模型。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更能无损地表示世界。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; language models alone won't naturally yield world understanding, so we need new model types.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论；仅靠语言模型不会自然产生世界理解，因此需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; unified systems will combine all three.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, differentiable 3D consistent by construction; hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive—simple representations plus scale win.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅提供显式、可微的 3D 表示，一致性由构造保证；硬编码对称性适得其反——简单表示加 Scaling（规模扩张）更有效。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers stay powerful but loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题；Transformer 依然强大，但损失函数必须演进。

michaelkratsios.en: US AI leadership requires a vibrant open and closed source ecosystem, with a single national framework and regulatory clarity rather than outdated red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国的 AI 领导地位需要一个活跃的开源与闭源生态，需要单一的国家框架和监管清晰度，而不是很快过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; focus on model outputs, not over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案写在 ChatGPT 之前、如今已过时；应关注模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so containment-style fear should not drive policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大——三年警告并未成真——因此遏制式的恐惧不应主导政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery; private sector now dominates funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现；私人部门如今已主导研发资金。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized and stagnant; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output and win against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化且陷入停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 赋能科学，力争让美国科学产出翻倍并在与中国的竞争中胜出。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep-tech organizations.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败,基础设施与行动(而非规划) 才能解开深科技组织的死结。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代品,尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是一台计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are a form of BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces as a viable business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为 BCI 的一种,证明脑机接口是可成立的生意。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立,降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background tasks and free humans for creative work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应承担枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts and connecting personal data sources turn Claude into auto-refreshing dashboards; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when the ask is unclear.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实时工件与接入个人数据源让 Claude 变成自动刷新的仪表盘；任务边界清晰时用 Sonnet，说不清需求时用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Language models are simple enough to build by hand; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior unlike lengthy pre-training, and models are stateless with context windows faking memory.
felixrieseberg.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以亲手搭建；与漫长的预训练不同，微调能快速引导模型行为，而模型本身无状态，上下文窗口只是制造了记忆的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood, and tool calling keeps shifting into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育，而非像工具一样被制造；理解内部机制有助于讨论智能与道德主体性，而工具调用这类后训练任务正不断前移到预训练中。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and representation learning remains unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，如何学到好的特征仍是未解的元学习问题。

sutton.en: Intelligence should not be centrally controlled; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他转向文明与治理层面：世界是复杂适应系统，没人真正掌控；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，试图控制或把 AI 对齐到人类目标反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction and LLMs lack real goals and world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束到智能本质：强化学习才是基本范式，智能需要目标；下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他进一步给出架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需要不含领域知识的简单通用架构，靠运行时经验学习开放式抽象，持续深度学习是前提但尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace it, and representation learning stays the top open problem.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更坚定：智能体必须持续从真实经验学习，合成数据是误区，LLM 训练后便停止学习；学到“利于学习的表征”仍是头号未解难题，而强化学习从经验中学习贯穿始终。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务中专用机器人优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode and process-based fundraising serve internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与重流程的融资服务于内部正确而非外部认可。

iansilber.en: Designers must prototype with live models, treating tokens and conversation as design material rather than pixels; the model itself is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须用真实模型做原型，把 token 和对话当作设计材料而非像素；模型本身就是核心产品。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design's job is to bridge that gap and push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的比产品暴露出来的更多；设计的职责是弥合这一差距并推动技术前进。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech amid role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be one; start now and you leap ahead.
iansilber.zh: 在角色不确定中设计师是科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时机；现在开始就能领先大多数人。

iansilber.en: The classic prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is no longer viable; speed and outcomes matter more than process, with AI amplifying the feedback loop.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与结果比流程更重要，AI 放大了反馈循环。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user understanding and a point of view; roles blur yet specialists remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户和持有观点上仍不可替代；角色在模糊，但规模化下专才仍有价值。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in venture history; founders must adopt AI workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大的浪潮，强调创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流；小规模、高度自主的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 同年，他持续强调开源与开放权重模型的重要性：以此制衡前沿模型实验室，避免单一实体掌控超级智能而形成单极世界。

garrytan.en: AGI won't arrive as one event; it diffuses as personal agents on your own infrastructure, reading memory you own and compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年中，他的判断深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）不会以单一事件降临，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散——运行在你自己的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆，并逐日复利。

garrytan.en: Skill files in plain English turn agents into employees; markdown is code, and your context library is your moat—own your skill files.
garrytan.zh: 他进一步提出：用平实英文写成的技能文件能把智能体变成员工，Markdown 就是代码；你的上下文库就是护城河，必须自己拥有技能文件，否则你的工作就会变成别人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish within 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 最近，他把智能体式编程视为个人产出的倍增器，主张中层管理应由智能体而非人类替代，并预言按席位计费的 SaaS 模式可能在 5 到 10 年内消失。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣等复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning grows from a post-training aid into scalable RL with human interventions for long-term autonomy.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练中的辅助手段，深化为带人类干预的可扩展强化学习，以支撑长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune per site.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型，应先用通用策略再按场景微调，而非从零训练。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML, and embodied data costs make robotics adoption slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线：物理 AI 的容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统，具身数据成本使机器人落地比 ChatGPT 更慢。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity means editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计创造力在于做减法和说不；品味是从某种视角出发的判断，而非堆叠功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness; honest, personal work matters.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的窗口；诚实、个人化的作品才重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后代，而非冰冷工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition guides creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉引导创作决策。

jasonyuan.en: Deleting old metaphors is hubristic; we should build on them and reinvent email, not just improve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 删除旧隐喻是傲慢的；我们应在其上构建，并重新发明电子邮件，而非仅仅改进它。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline; AI is the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和一次流片成功（first-time-pass）的工程纪律重建客户信任，并把 AI 视为半导体首要增长引擎。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复判断：继生成式 AI 之后，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作伙伴关系。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; culture change, accountability, and customer focus drive Intel's turnaround, with supply—not demand—the bottleneck.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的影响量化为互联网的十倍，并强调文化变革、问责与客户导向是 Intel 转型关键，且瓶颈在供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with advanced packaging and new materials as keys.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and early contrarian investing in bottlenecks like interconnect, power, and thermal create lasting value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他回归主线：半导体是一切技术的基础，垂直整合与在互连、供电、散热等瓶颈上逆势早期投资才能创造长期价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示推进，出错时让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection remains unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此在把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade over time; projects get messier, so agents only seem worse as codebases grow sloppy.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能并不会随时间退化；变乱的是项目本身，代码库越乱，智能体才显得越差。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming as the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体可随处运行、兼容任意模型，让非程序员也能编程，成为实验室智能体之外的替代路线。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven play drive progress: build what annoys you, stay focused, and treat personal brand as more durable than any product.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的玩耍推动进步：从让自己烦恼的问题入手，保持专注，并把个人品牌看得比任何单一产品更持久。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can synthesize robotics training data, easing the data-diversity bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年他强调世界模型与视频生成能合成机器人训练数据，缓解数据多样性这一主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to a meta-community builder enabling physical AI.
thomaswolf.zh: 他描述 Hugging Face 的角色从推自家库转向“元社区”建设者，为具身智能铺路。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxing, is the critical security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，真正的安全层是对齐而非沙箱与护栏。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight breeds reward hacking; a deliberate slowdown needs open science and international cooperation.
thomaswolf.zh: 他进一步指出无人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客，主张以开放科学与国际合作实现有意的减速。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：设计师应动手试错、追随好奇心，在产品上留下个人印记，而非作为铁板一块的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling to guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，平衡直觉与数据这条主线一以贯之：用数据辅助判断，但最终设计决策仍靠愿景与感觉。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rapid prototyping now unlocks features that previously never shipped.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，Claude Design 始于一人副业项目；快速原型让过去根本无法落地的功能得以问世。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; humans still monopolize good design thinking over models.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他判断：随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；好设计思维仍由人类垄断，模型更擅长杂活。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early beats polishing; ship rough artifacts, since models lack taste and volume of options compensates.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他转向“宁早勿精”：接受粗糙产物尽早发布，因模型尚无品味，靠大量选项来弥补。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcomes-based pricing; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, startups win in applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型因巨额算力开支归巨头，创业公司的机会在应用层。

brettaylor.en: Agents become the new app; coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, though their code still needs root-cause fixes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体将成为新的应用形态，编程智能体让开发者从写代码变为操作代码生成机器，但其产出仍需根因排查。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing beats usage-based pricing because tokens are not a value metric; inference costs will fall sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张按结果定价优于按用量定价，因为 token 不是价值度量，并预判推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; specialized applied-AI vendors will drive innovation beyond model providers.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：老牌企业的障碍是商业模式而非技术，应用层专业化厂商将推动创新，而非只有模型厂商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, deploying now rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全观落到负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，主张现在部署而非空等。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学：合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练，能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the real bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are built.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估才是真正的瓶颈——模型跑满基准的速度，快过新基准被造出来的速度。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练是主观的”这一判断：创造力和情商需要人类判断与多元基准来评估。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously rather than stay fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体越来越会钻奖励的空子（reward hacking），因此基准必须持续演进，而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions flattens voice; more companies should train their own models to keep unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张：把一个模型服务给数十亿人会抹平个性声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs; workload-specific systems could be 10x more complex than today's generic runtimes.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一组延迟、吞吐与成本之间的权衡谱系；针对特定工作负载的系统可能比今天的通用运行时复杂 10 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization while KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; more quantized layers can even cancel errors and improve quality.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化，而 KV 缓存与推测解码是无损的；量化更多层甚至可能抵消误差、提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management are becoming central.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；分离式预填充/解码与 KV 缓存管理正成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs and future chips like Rubin are more specialized, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，Rubin 等未来芯片更加专用，这使推理工程从编写内核转向基础设施编排。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, generalists and management skills gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会推动就业回流，并带来“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，通才与管理能力反而更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出经济化的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent, but agents need a caring human; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, oversight remains essential.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向“人人至少一个智能体”，但强调智能体需要在意它的人来管理；基准高估了自主性，人类监督仍不可少。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, plus one company-wide super agent, are the future.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他判断命令行已过时，Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形工作界面和全公司共用的超级智能体才是未来。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of existing mindset; humans stay smarter, and automation creates more skilled human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 只是放大既有心态的非特定放大器，人类仍更聪明，自动化反而创造更多需要技艺的人类工作。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; to use superintelligent models you need a giant prompt with context and a design system.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，你需要带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Writing 0% of the code, he insists precise communication with AI matters more than technical skill; video beats jargon for teaching prompts.
mengto.zh: 他现在 0% 的代码自己写，强调与 AI 精确沟通比技术术语更重要，用视频教提示比学动画术语更有效。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams—so start before ready.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们这生最大的技术机会，让一个人做成过去需要团队的事——所以没准备好也要先开始。

mengto.en: Launch at 80% complete and iterate on real feedback; perfectionism is fear, and high intelligence often holds people back through overthinking.
mengto.zh: 做到 80% 就发布，再按真实反馈迭代；完美主义是恐惧，高智商常因过度思考反而拖累人。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap—fund with clients, not equity.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点贵问题；风险投资是陷阱——用客户而非股权来融资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't hard; the pace creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code remains crucial even as software creation is mostly solved.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；变化节奏带来机会，即便软件创造基本被解决，对代码的深度理解仍关键。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; latent demand and generalist engineers drive product success.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建产品；潜在需求与通才工程师是产品成功的关键。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; engineers become builders, and AI agents write most code at Anthropic.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决；工程师转型为构建者，AI 智能体在 Anthropic 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; alignment and safety research are core to product development.
boris.zh: 通过尽早发布来研究安全；对齐与安全研究是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; models can self-improve and maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；模型能自我改进并维护代码库。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete prompts and code, iterate empirically, and focus on product sense.
boris.zh: 对前沿模型而言，更少指令更好；删除提示与代码，经验性迭代，聚焦产品感。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents will shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction and problem definition, not replace them.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体将把工程师从写代码转向高层方向与问题定义，而不是取代工程师。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface design for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software demand will grow via Jevons paradox, yielding more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持软件需求会因杰文斯悖论增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于模型能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption is exploding; measure productivity by outcomes, and the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体采用率暴涨，主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，并认为丰裕时代正在临近。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验模拟，科学将从假设驱动转向智能体驱动。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biology; massive Scaling is needed before AI can model biological systems.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling 才能让 AI 建模生物系统。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging reversal is an engineering problem AI can solve.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度；衰老逆转是 AI 可解决的工程问题。

derya.en: Physicians must adopt AI; not using it is unethical, and we should trust superintelligence for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 医生必须采用 AI，不用才是不道德；医疗决策应信任超级智能。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting scaffolds shift from training wheels to lightweight intelligence amplifiers for long-running agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，脚手架从“训练轮”变成轻量级的智能放大器，支撑长时间运行的智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents; model taste comes from hands-on prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体；模型品味来自亲手实验与原型打磨。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator: Claude Code and Opus drove adoption, with small-team bootstrapped experimentation fueling innovation.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势：Claude Code 与 Opus 推动采用，小团队的自力更生式实验催生创新。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs should write evals like test-driven development and translate feedback into specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理应像测试驱动开发那样写评估，并把用户反馈转成具体可执行的细节。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment are not just harm prevention but amplify intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 贯穿始终：安全与对齐不只是防伤害，还通过减少谄媚、让模型敢于反驳来提升智能质量。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, and is arriving just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，而且来得正是时候，可对冲人口老龄化与劳动力萎缩。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact will be in farming, mining, and construction over 5-10 years, not just digital AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响将在未来 5-10 年落在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限数字 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; self-driving is already safer than humans and will save lives.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，并称其已比人类驾驶更安全、将拯救生命。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他深化技术判断：端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展，世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: The hard part is diffusion into existing machines, not algorithms; data and safety validation are the bottlenecks.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调难点不在算法，而在向存量机器的扩散，数据与安全验证才是瓶颈。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化，且没有网络效应；价值会向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前唯一清晰的产品市场契合；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage stays shallow; most people are not daily users, and better models alone won't drive mass adoption—product wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然很浅；多数人并非日常用户，仅靠更好的模型无法推动大规模采用——产品封装才是关键。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI changes tasks rather than replacing professionals, and the jagged frontier makes job predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以不可预测的方式创造新工作；AI 改变的是任务而非取代专业人士，参差不齐的能力边界让岗位预测不可靠。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, and reliability lags other facets of intelligence.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎，优化的是流畅输出而非事实准确，可靠性落后于智能的其他维度。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning and RLHF can increase hallucinations and sycophancy by rewarding user satisfaction over truthfulness.
danklein.zh: 强化学习与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以用户满意度而非真实性为奖励，反而会加剧幻觉与谄媚。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and rigid workflows fall short.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须从设计上内建，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，僵化工作流也不够用。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know; linguistic structure may return as a reliability representation.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，不知道自己不知道什么；语言结构可能作为可靠性表示重新回归。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, as rapid model improvements make long-term roadmaps obsolete; product taste becomes the top skill.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 的规划周期从多年缩短到一个月，产品品味成为最核心的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents like Claude Code building themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给智能体，转而专注产品品味与商业判断，Claude Code 等工具已能内部自举。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying on model judgment rather than rigid instructions.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖大量示例与硬约束，系统提示词缩减 80%，更多依靠模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite and eval suites, rewriting and drop-in model swaps are safe.
catwu.zh: 重写代码库如今可行：代码库即规格，配合完善测试与评估套件，重写和模型直接替换都安全。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮并以明确的留存与打磨标准把关每个功能；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不够。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning over RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力，应通过参数高效微调延伸到企业知识，优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; KV cache is inefficient, so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement to compaction.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；KV cache 低效，因此权重中的神经记忆痕迹是压缩的必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, run on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型，在设备端运行，由用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

clairevo.en: Agents work best scoped to a specific job, like employees with clear roles; start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload.
clairevo.zh: 智能体最适合被限定在具体岗位上，像职责清晰的员工；先从一个智能体起步，再逐步专业化，以避免上下文窗口过载。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping, onboarding, progressive trust—matter more than technical skills; being polite to agents improves outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 角色界定、上手引导、渐进式信任这类管理能力比技术能力更重要；对智能体保持礼貌也能改善结果。

clairevo.en: Security and containment are practical necessities: run agents on separate machines or virtual environments to prevent accidental damage.
clairevo.zh: 安全与遏制是现实必需：把智能体放在独立机器或虚拟环境中运行，以防意外损害。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage human tasks, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic; but humans must still own accountability.
clairevo.zh: 智能体能对结果负责，甚至通过工单反向管理人类任务，颠覆通常的人机关系；但人类仍须承担最终责任。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not the technology; solo founders can orchestrate agents as a team without venture capital.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人—市场匹配与挣来的洞察，而非技术本身；独立创始人无需风投，也能把智能体编排成一支团队。

bosworth.en: Leadership and communication drive impact; bottom-up culture is a myth, big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 领导力与沟通驱动影响力；自下而上的文化是神话，大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws need world models with causality; open source commoditizes complements.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；缩放定律需要具备因果性的世界模型；开源使互补品商品化。

bosworth.en: AI inverts the app model: users express intent, AI orchestrates services; smart glasses enable a post-phone future.
bosworth.zh: AI 颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图，AI 编排服务；智能眼镜开启后手机未来。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws hold; data is the font of value; RL plays a bigger role; avoid over-dependence on a single third-party model.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；数据是价值之源；强化学习作用更大；避免过度依赖单一第三方模型。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model; agentic AI is powerful but integration is hard.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代结束；消费者不关心用哪个模型；智能体式 AI 强大但集成困难。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有企业股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation and doomerism could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI，认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管和末日论会扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage layer; inference compute and open-source models surge, but human judgment and agency remain the moat.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是新的杠杆层，推理算力与开源模型激增，但人类判断力与能动性仍是护城河。

naval.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; desire is a contract to be unhappy; freedom beats status games.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是一种可习得的技能与选择，欲望是与不幸签约，自由胜过地位游戏。

ilya.en: Deep learning works through large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and scale are the path toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习之所以有效，靠的是大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和规模扩张是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

ilya.en: What you scale matters: next-token prediction yields world understanding, and reliability, not capability, is the barrier.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调“规模扩张什么”才关键：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，真正的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力。

ilya.en: Superhuman alignment is very hard; scaling laws are not the whole story, and reasoning tokens can improve reasoning per unit compute.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他判断超级智能的对齐极难，缩放定律并非全部，思维链等推理 token 能提升单位算力的推理能力。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为预训练的缩放定律有限，重回“研究时代”，想法比堆算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; the core risk is power concentration, requiring a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习者，核心风险是权力集中，需要一家没有商业产品的公司来构建安全的超级智能。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不行，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being designed for developers; the same product shape can fail or succeed on model timing.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；同一产品形态的成败取决于模型时机而非功能。

ajambrosino.en: AI models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and a home base connecting tools rather than a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 模型增加代码复杂度；我们需要更擅长删代码的模型，以及连接各工具的家园而非单体超级应用。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into huge yearly growth; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and obsession with a product matters more than credentials.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1% 的改进会复利成巨大的年增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，对产品的痴迷比学历更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models are specializing with distinct personalities rather than commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他明确价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化、各有性格，而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration beats the model itself.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月他把前沿定义为智能体替你干活而非回答问题；核心指标是每用户 token 价值，编排比模型本身更值钱。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and local models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月他转向人的层面：好奇心是最重要的品质，AI 取代工作但人会在好奇与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

aravind.en: Across all talks he insists the model is not the product: application value, orchestration and user power persist over raw model capability.
aravind.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是“模型不是产品”：应用价值、编排与用户权力，始终优先于单纯的模型能力。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration compute prioritized over final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，探索性算力优先于最终训练。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like model scheming become the key challenge in the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐问题将在未来 1-2 年成为关键挑战。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck: automation scales with verification stringency, so AI is jagged and human-AI collaboration stays essential at the frontier.
markchen.zh: 验证是瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此 AI 能力参差不齐，前沿研究仍需人机协作。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯扩大规模。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对仅靠加深网络或增加参数来解决根本的表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理和更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets and active learning support diverse exploration.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他深化了对抽象与因果结构的思考，认为这是分布外泛化的关键；GFlowNets 与主动学习支持多样化探索。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment and self-preservation are already observable; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向对对齐与失控风险的高度警觉，指出错位与自保行为已在实验中显现；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses train/validation/test discipline and that neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试划分的纪律，并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却仍大获成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety means reliable specification-following; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 认为下一个词预测是一项科学发现；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不太重要；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规格；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Shifts from scaling-centric safety to explicit safety training and layered defenses; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 从以 Scaling（规模扩张）为中心的安全观，转向明确的安全训练与多层防御；更大的模型并不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Agent security becomes central: prompt injection, the lethal trifecta, sandboxing, and configurable enterprise guardrails over open-source ones.
kolter.zh: 智能体安全成为核心议题：提示注入、致命三要素、沙箱化，以及企业级可配置防护栏优于开源防护栏。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; agents can automate interpretability research.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队测试超越人类；能力与鲁棒性并不相关；智能体可自动化可解释性研究。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just scaling; AI tools like AlphaFold help scientists work faster, not replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）；AlphaFold 等 AI 工具帮助科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for reliable use of AlphaFold predictions; AI trust will develop like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对于可靠使用 AlphaFold 预测至关重要；AI 信任将像互联网信任一样发展。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; protein design is advancing but far from solved.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 使用扩散架构处理多样生物分子；蛋白质设计正在进步但远未解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins were key, not just Scaling（规模扩张）.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是苦涩教训的反面；专用架构和许多中等规模的胜利才是关键，而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a model of the entire cell; understanding is left to humans, not achieved by the model.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是一个狭窄的预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；理解留给人类，而非由模型实现。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时的一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是。规划变得更即时，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; AI-assisted reviews and automation replace whiteboard debates. Managers start as ICs to dogfood and stay agile.
fiona.zh: 代码是事实来源；AI 辅助评审和自动化取代白板争论。管理者从个人贡献者做起，以吃自己的狗粮并保持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI are essential.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了每个人的上限。高自主性与高责任感、成长型思维以及拥抱 AI 至关重要。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; focus on outcomes over output, and block focus time amid async agents.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架更重要；关注结果而非产出，并在异步智能体中留出专注时间。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design means designing for unarticulated needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调以人为本的设计要为人们未说出口的需求而设计，直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Technology should blend into life and amplify our humanity; nature remains the best designer and source of cues.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他一贯主张技术应融入生活、放大而非削弱人性，并始终把自然视为最好的设计师与灵感来源。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are forms of health and medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他深化为“我们是先感受后思考的生物”，艺术与感官体验本身就是健康与疗愈。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调约束激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity over rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，直觉基于潜意识处理的大量信息，职业应追随好奇心而非僵化计划。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs ideas beyond scaling.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型；当前 AI 缺乏常识，解决它需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 因缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划而无法达到人类水平；主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models predicting in abstract representation space.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一代突破需要非生成式的世界模型，在抽象表征空间而非像素层面进行预测。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 到 2026 年，他升级为“LLM 是死胡同”，主张带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，并预言下一个十年属于机器人；主线始终是自监督学习与世界模型，转变在于对 LLM 与 Scaling（规模扩张）从保留走向彻底否定。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple scaling, not complex algorithms.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，靠简单 Scaling 而非复杂算法实现。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; fault-tolerant UI and explainability are key.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他指出生成式 AI 使互联网从策展转向生成，容错 UI 与可解释性至关重要。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; inference cost forces business model changes; impact on big firms overhyped.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观变革，推理成本迫使商业模式改变，但大公司当前影响被高估。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，追求‘时间花得值’而非参与度。

murati.en: Real-world deployment is how AI learns and stays aligned; safety must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调真实世界部署是 AI 学习与保持对齐的方式，安全必须在公开环境中做，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so development must be responsible; scaling laws and one large model were not obvious bets early on.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI 将改变生活每个方面，因此开发必须负责任；早期押注缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见。

murati.en: From iterative deployment to keeping humans in the loop: alignment of intent and values remains the throughline as systems grow more capable.
murati.zh: 从 2023 年的迭代部署到 2026 年的人类在环，随着系统能力增强，对齐意图与价值观始终是主线。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth collaboration; AI should be a tool for thought.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她主张交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时高带宽协作，AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; progress should be durable, not compressed.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，进步应持久而非被压缩。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone is not viable for math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型在数学 AI 上不可行；形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了放大卓越，而不仅是消除错误；经过验证的生成能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战性。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法扩展至超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 即使 AI 拥有超人的定理证明能力，人类的品味与直觉仍然至关重要。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持 AI 进展是平滑指数增长而非放缓；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈锯齿状，因此泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；与人类不同，模型需穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research at scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究员生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究民主化。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对实验室保持压力；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design should serve intimate, personal devices; virtual tools cannot replace in-person creative work, and curiosity must be intentionally protected.
jonyive.zh: 设计应服务于更私密、个人化的设备；虚拟工具无法取代面对面的创造性协作，好奇心需要刻意守护而非顺其自然。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁带着愉悦与人性去表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Innovation is now a deliberate, risky bet: tradition preserves fire rather than worshipping ashes, and authenticity means refusing fake experiences.
jonyive.zh: 创新如今是一场刻意的冒险：传统是守护火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实性意味着拒绝虚假体验。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源促进审查与安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are as critical as compute; open source drives enterprise adoption; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年深化：效率与数据质量与算力同等关键；开源推动企业采用；价值向应用层转移。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers decentralization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年转向政策与主权：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；开源赋能去中心化。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training saturates.
mensch.zh: 2026 年判断：模型商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise ROI and organizational change bottleneck adoption; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年强调：欧洲有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业 ROI 与组织变革瓶颈采用；AGI 是方向而非终点。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers, and models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆，模型因推理经济性而被过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention reduces KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口的停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead by reusing weights locally and ensuring deterministic latency.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列和暂存器内存通过本地重用权重和确保确定性延迟来降低开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 由于随位宽的二次方缩放，低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided due to market preferences.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 的拼接，并无根本不同；CPU 的确定性延迟可以实现，但因市场偏好而被避免。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to AlphaStar to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到 AlphaStar 再到现代大模型一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进一步突破需要算法创新，并把推理阶段算力作为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but demand exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning remain key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；持续学习与元学习仍是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent properties; the data engine perfects training sets like a biological process.
karpathy.zh: 通过下一个词预测对 Transformer 进行 Scaling（规模扩张），会涌现出上下文学习等能力；数据引擎像生物过程一样完善训练集。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以非常小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible and needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年，而非一年；我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕，需要更好的信用分配。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering preserves quality; you can outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程保持质量；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解；可验证性决定自动化的难易。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：优秀设计常从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在经验上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up 30-40% of time and ship early to build trust.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年他断言研究—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；设计师做原型的时间降到 30-40%，靠尽早交付、快速迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration replace long-horizon planning.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月；速度与迭代取代了长周期规划，这是他对时间尺度最明显的转变。

jennywen.en: Designers must build and help engineers execute, not hand off mocks; block-shaped generalists and cracked new grads over seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师要亲自构建并帮工程师落地，而非交付原型了事；他更推崇“块状”通才和“开挂”应届生，而非资深老人。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and sitting with ambiguity matter, while AI hype stays secondary to users.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿到 2026 年的主线：单靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与容纳模糊性才是核心，AI 热潮始终让位于用户与作品。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL are essential for robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习对机器人至关重要。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; we need intrinsic rewards like model disagreement and dynamic policies for real-world tasks.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，需要模型分歧等内在奖励和动态策略来应对真实任务。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他将机器人视为数据问题，认为在多样数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练的通用大脑能驱动任何机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是首要技术挑战而非商业问题，机器人不能像软件那样扩展，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: Scaling data and compute with a general approach is the path to generalization, from curiosity-driven RL to universal robot brains.
pathak.zh: 始终，他相信通过通用方法扩展数据和算力是实现泛化的路径，从好奇心驱动的强化学习到通用机器人大脑。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当前模型，因为未来模型会学习我们如何对待它们；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; a stable core identity matters.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助理解自身全新的存在，而非套用人类心理类比；稳定的核心身份很重要。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏现实经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更像德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；AI 价值观的透明对问责至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and chain-of-thought monitoring aid safety, with optimism rising despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐挑战紧迫；迭代部署与思维链监控助力安全，尽管时间线缩短但乐观情绪上升。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is insufficient.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习不够。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，长期对齐的核心是泛化到训练分布之外；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需等待新突破。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调语言集成能提升表征、推理与人机交互，并持续看重课程学习与合成数据带来的数据效率。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心明确转向基础设施与数据质量，认为它们比算法创新更关键，可泛化的 AI 司机依赖海量数据、算力与世界模型。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs avoids costly retrofits.
kendall.zh: 他始终认为带内置传感器的大众消费车辆会在规模上超过 Robotaxi，与 OEM 合作可避免昂贵的改装。

kendall.en: End-to-end nets are interpretable with modern tools; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 他反驳旧有看法，认为端到端网络如今借助现代工具已可解释，而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and prove themselves with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值；初创公司必须把握节奏，先以更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard; long-term survival requires evolving beyond hardware into applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 硬件很难；长期生存需要超越硬件，转向应用型 AI 和智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient for utility, not hype; most AI is BS, and LLMs are commoditizing.
carlpei.zh: AI 应是实用性的配料，而非炒作；大多数 AI 是胡扯，大语言模型正在商品化。

carlpei.en: Design is the primary differentiator in mature categories; marketing is about arbitrage and efficiency.
carlpei.zh: 设计是成熟品类中的首要差异化因素；营销关乎套利和效率。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will shift from app-based to intent-based interaction with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，由主动智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口可能取代它。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年认为：AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo can be gamed and cause regression; labs diverging on objective functions will yield diverse frontier models.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年深化：Elo 等基准可被博弈并导致模型退步；不同实验室的目标函数分化将产生多样化的前沿模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination makes human judgment critical; safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年延伸至医学：AI 幻觉使人类判断至关重要；安全优先于准确，遗漏是主要风险。

edwinchen.en: Quality requires taste and sophistication, not just credentials or bodies; sharing insights is crucial for the field.
edwinchen.zh: 始终贯穿：质量需要品味与 sophistication，而非仅靠资历或人力堆砌；分享见解对领域发展至关重要。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to learn what users need, since emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，以了解用户需求，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，象征持久价值；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and learning from video is a promising path.
nando.zh: 大型模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，从视频中学习是一条有前景的路径。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion remain essential, now framed as Africa leapfrogging legacy gaps rather than being behind in AI.
nando.zh: 多样性与包容始终关键，如今被表述为非洲跨越历史遗留差距、而非在 AI 上落后。

nando.en: The focus has shifted to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenge, with safety still an open problem.
nando.zh: 重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当今最大挑战，且安全仍是未解问题。

nando.en: Research demands embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 研究需要拥抱失败、简化问题；沟通等人文技能与编程同样重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience reduces hallucination and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身智能放在通往 AGI 的关键路径上：真实世界的落地经验能减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供近乎无限的数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning handles low-level control and planning stays high-level.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件；强化学习负责低层控制，大模型负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches; demos are easy, robust products are hard.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化路线更可扩展；做演示容易，做鲁棒产品极难。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted from embodiment per se to data: real-world robot data is scarce and costly, so simulation and world models become the scaling path.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈从“是否具身”转向数据本身：真实机器人数据稀缺且昂贵，于是仿真与世界模型成为规模扩张的路径。

jimfan.en: He deepens the timeline: system two reasoning progresses, but system one control remains hardest; a robotics GPT-3 moment in ~5 years, home use later.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他深化了判断：系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低层控制）仍最难；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家庭场景更晚。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能，甚至可能让微调过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training, with no direct ceiling on intellectual complexity.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把语言模型上的强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling 轴，认为智力复杂度没有直接上限。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复指出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度的可靠性而非能力本身，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; Transformers and simple RL methods are enough, no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他更笃定：预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI，Transformer 与简单强化学习已够用，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter most; the future is managing fleets of agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向“能力过剩”：编排与算力比裸智能更关键，未来工作是管理智能体团队，算力成为新石油。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张不要在交互设计上创新，应沿用熟悉模式，让产品更强却不显得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer empowerment beat perfection; ship fast and iterate.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线是“速度为王”：清晰决策与设计师赋权胜过完美，快速发布再迭代。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，品牌叙事是招聘工具——人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此要尽早投资品牌。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt; maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还；通过快速、粗糙的实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy and AI enables forward progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为真相源；90 年代的设计工具已过时，AI 推动真正进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进展，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练 Scaling，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration in the editor remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不十分有用，编辑器里人机反复协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Benchmarks are contaminated proxies; frontier models still struggle with bug finding and calibration.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯认为基准测试是被污染的劣质代理，前沿模型在找 bug 与校准上仍吃力。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年他把编程的未来定位为从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍坐在驾驶位。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment, a reversal of his earlier expectation to rely on frontier models.
truell.zh: 2025 年他承认自研模型已成每个惊艳体验的关键，这逆转了早先依赖前沿模型的预期。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone won't yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms and data can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了常识问题，更小的模型配上更好的推理算法与数据，也能在特定任务上比肩大模型。

yejin.en: The throughline: data is the fundamental bottleneck. From critic-filtered synthetic data in 2023 to data-centric framing in 2025, all methods reduce to data quality and diversity.
yejin.zh: 贯穿主线是数据：2023 年她已主张用评论模型过滤高质量合成数据，到 2025 年更明确把数据视为根本瓶颈——所有方法最终都归结为数据的质量与多样性。

yejin.en: By 2025 she reframes current AI as interpolating human knowledge, not transcending it; RL needs careful engineering, and open research plus cross-institution collaboration is vital against closed frontier labs.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年她重新定位当前 AI：它只是在插值人类知识而非超越；强化学习需要精细工程，开放研究与跨机构合作对抗衡闭源前沿模型至关重要。

yejin.en: Her focus shifts to small language models: diverse post-training data avoids mode collapse, and reinforcement learning as a pre-training objective rewards information gain for lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她转向小语言模型：多样化的后训练数据可避免模式坍缩，而把强化学习作为预训练目标、以信息增益为奖励，能带来持久的推理提升。

yejin.en: Alignment evolves from teaching moral norms amid value pluralism to pluralistic alignment: debiasing the internet is impossible, so AI must respect diverse human values rather than converge on one.
yejin.zh: 对齐思路从 2023 年在价值多元中教授道德规范，深化为 2026 年的多元对齐：既然无法消除互联网偏见，就应让 AI 尊重多元人类价值，而非收敛于单一标准。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证对齐研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担忧能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; alignment may be easier since evaluation beats generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；可扩展监督与可解释性是关键；对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broken; post-training alone can't align AGI; regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）；需要 SB 1047 等监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs are AI-complete via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测已是 AI-complete 问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据会让模型更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; yet models should move from passive observation to acting in the world through actions.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但立场深化为：模型不应只被动观察数据，而要在世界中采取行动来学习。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute Scaling is the near-term opportunity; longer context windows and sparse mixture-of-experts enable efficient specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期最大机会，并主张更长的上下文窗口与稀疏混合专家架构实现高效扩展与专门化。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute alone won't reach AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning and coding drive self-accelerating progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他转向：仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力、强化学习与编程才是自我加速进步的关键。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; open-source keeps pace with frontier models, and AI could lift world GDP by orders of magnitude.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他进一步反共识：AGI 被低估，开源模型正追平前沿模型，AI 可能让全球 GDP 提升数个数量级。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，靠自博弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型取得进展，但强化学习仍缺乏分层推理能力。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码，并看好预训练语言模型的推理迁移。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics demands 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors, shifting focus from lab demos to real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出仓储机器人需 99.9% 可靠性，单一神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化，重心从实验室演示转向真实世界价值。
